text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm assembling a short FAQ + migration guide for the v1->v2 API deprecation. Need to lock down SDK snippet changes, model alias mapping, and redirect plan. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 :eyes:

jake: Replied on the PR — looks solid. Two asks: 1) include a TypeScript and Python snippet for the embed model rename, 2) clarify behavior if users still call the v1 endpoint (what's the fallback?).

maya: Good calls. Proposed embed snippet (old -> new):
```ts
// v1 (old)
await client.v1.embeddings({ model: 'embed-large', input });
// v2 (new)
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rdw/embedding-1', input });
```
We should show the minimal change + note about rate-limit semantics.

erin: Also add a short note about streaming framing differences — some apps parse streaming tokens differently now. Suggest a tiny example of the new `stream` payload and the newline framing.

tom: Ops note: if we publish docs that say "switch immediately" before the redirect deploy, support will get flooded. Can we gate the public-facing migration guide behind the redirect rollout?

maya: Yes — plan is: merge internal-only docs first, coordinate redirect deploy, then flip public page and update the quickstart snippets. I'm adding a section in the PR with the rollout timeline and owners.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: docs-redirects v2 -> v1-routes will run on 2026-03-25T05:00:00Z (canary first).

jake: I'll update the SDK examples in separate PRs: one for JS/TS, one for Python. I'll also add a short compatibility helper function for teams that rely on the old param names. Example: `compatV1toV2(req)`.

maya: Please also include a note about the model fallback map — some customers used `embed-large` and `embed-large-2x`. We need a clear mapping table and a sentence about quality differences.

erin: I'll produce the mapping and paste it into the PR description. Will include recommended quantized variants where applicable.

tom: Support doc needed: quick rollback instructions if the redirect causes issues (how to point clients back to v1 shim, and contact SRE). I'll draft that and link it from the PR too.

jake: ETA for SDK PRs: 3 hours for the snippet changes + tests. I'll tag @maya when ready.

maya: Thanks. Action items in PR description so far:
- [maya] finalize FAQ text + merge internal draft
- [jake] JS/TS snippet PR + compat helper
- [jake] Python snippet PR
- [erin] model alias mapping + quantization notes
- [tom] support rollback doc + SRE contact steps
- [ops] run canary redirect then full rollout (deploy-bot scheduled)

maya: Small UX ask: can we add a short "what changed for streaming" callout in the Quickstart so users don't accidentally keep old parsing code.

erin: Putting that example under 4 lines so it fits the quickstart. Also flagging the diff in the changelog.

maya: Cool. Let's aim to merge internal doc + SDK snippets after the canary succeeds. Follow-up sync tomorrow 11am PT — calendar invite sent.

tom: +1. I'll be on the canary watch.

jake: I'll drop a link to the final PRs here when ready.

maya: thanks team — will update PR now with the rollout checklist and estimated timelines.
